ablation: pool positive and negative common-market responses
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A through Frontier-F development evidence is already observed. Frontier-G is a new development research look, not a fresh holdout. 2023+ remains excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: weekly structural-state changes should limit unnecessary target changes
failure_mode: conditional response reduces to symmetric delay or common beta
falsifier: invert the positive-versus-negative shock response assignment
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Frontier-G exact implementation registered after prior campaign evidence; hypothesis provenance predates Frontier-G performance. Prior source: experiments/frontier_20260910c/response_sign_asymmetry/preregistration.json
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed development floor; do not retune after failure
thesis: Leaders that assimilate positive common-market shocks faster than negative shocks while residual trend is positive may exhibit favorable directional response asymmetry.
timing: completed daily bars only; all structural comparisons use trailing estimates and fixed historical lags
validation: 2023-2024 remains untouched during development selection; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
